title: Interpretable Feature Learning for RF Fingerprinting via Polar MKANs
abstract: arXiv:2608.19881v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Radio frequency (RF) fingerprinting authenticates wireless devices from hardware-induced I/Q impairments, typically with deep learning feature extractors that are accurate but opaque, limiting their use in security critical settings. We propose Polar Monotonic Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (Polar MKAN), a block partitioned monotonic encoder on polar inputs in which each latent dimension depends exclusively on magnitude or phase, yielding channel separation and monotone responses by construction. On a synthetic gain and carrier frequency offset (CFO) benchmark, Polar MKAN reaches 57.2 percent DCI Disentanglement versus at most 12.9 percent for unpartitioned baselines. We further evaluate the detection accuracy trade off on real data and the sensitivity to blind CFO compensation.

translated_title: 基于极性MKAN的RF指纹识别可解释特征学习
translated_abstract: 射频（RF）指纹识别通过硬件引起的I/Q损伤来认证无线设备，通常使用深度学习特征提取器，这些提取器准确但不透明，限制了它们在安全关键环境中的使用。我们提出了极性单调Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（Polar MKAN），这是一种在极性输入上构建的块分区单调编码器，其中每个潜在维度仅依赖于幅度或相位，从而通过构造实现通道分离和单调响应。在合成增益和载波频率偏移（CFO）基准测试中，Polar MKAN达到了57.2%的DCI解缠分数，而未分区基线最多仅为12.9%。我们进一步评估了真实数据上的检测准确率权衡以及对盲CFO补偿的敏感性。
tldr: 本文提出Polar MKAN网络，通过极性输入的分区单调编码实现RF指纹识别的可解释特征学习，显著提升解缠性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Polar MKAN, a partitioned monotonic encoder on polar inputs, achieving interpretable feature learning for RF fingerprinting with significantly improved disentanglement.
